problem:
$$
{x}^{′}(t)=[\begin{aligned}0 & -2 \\ 2 & 0\end{aligned}]x(t)+[\begin{aligned}-2t+6 \\ -2{t}^{2}\end{aligned}],\,x(0)=[\begin{aligned}10 \\ 12\end{aligned}]
$$

Find the missing coefficients in the solution to the initial value problem, shown above.

$x(t)=$ 
{{field-1}} 
$\,\cdot \,[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡(2t) \\ \operatorname{sin}⁡(2t)\end{aligned}]\,+$
{{field-2}}
$\,\cdot \,[\begin{aligned}-\operatorname{sin}⁡(2t) \\ \operatorname{cos}⁡(2t)\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}{t}^{2}-1 \\ -2t+3\end{aligned}].$
worked_solution:
We are told that the general solution to the system is 

$$
x(t)={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡(2t) \\ \operatorname{sin}⁡(2t)\end{aligned}]+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-\operatorname{sin}⁡(2t) \\ \operatorname{cos}⁡(2t)\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}{t}^{2}-1 \\ -2t+3\end{aligned}]
$$

where ${c}_{1},{c}_{2}$ are constants that are to be determined. 

Next, we find the values of ${c}_{1}$ and ${c}_{2}.$ Substituting $t=0$ into the general solution, we get the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}x(0) & =[\begin{aligned}10 \\ 12\end{aligned}] \\ {c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡(0) \\ \operatorname{sin}⁡(0)\end{aligned}]+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-\operatorname{sin}⁡(0) \\ \operatorname{cos}⁡(0)\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}{0}^{2}-1 \\ -2\cdot 0+3\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}10 \\ 12\end{aligned}] \\ {c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 3\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}10 \\ 12\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{c}_{1}-1 \\ {c}_{2}+3\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}10 \\ 12\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have the following system of linear equations:

$$
{\begin{aligned}{c}_{1}-1=10 \\ {c}_{2}+3=12\end{aligned}
$$

From the first equation, we get ${c}_{1}=11.$ From the second equation, we have ${c}_{2}=9.$

Therefore, the solution to the initial value problem is

$$
x(t)=11\cdot [\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡(2t) \\ \operatorname{sin}⁡(2t)\end{aligned}]+9\cdot [\begin{aligned}-\operatorname{sin}⁡(2t) \\ \operatorname{cos}⁡(2t)\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}{t}^{2}-1 \\ -2t+3\end{aligned}].
$$
